label: 2 — Interactive Code Generation (iter 1, cold)
summary: Cold codegen for sranger from canonical inputs. All 21 requirements traced. 4 issues flagged: 1 design choice on the terminal mode (no Final state per CLAUDE.md), 1 on the Move output encoding, 1 invented default (sensor no-reading value), 1 design choice combining SR-Beh2's event trigger with SR-GP1's guard.

issues.title: Terminal mode realised as absorbing live mode 'Halted', not a Final state
issues.raw: SR-DM1/SR-FR3/SR-Beh3/SR-Beh6 specify a terminal 'Final' mode. CLAUDE.md mandates that the theory-generated (primary) controller must NOT contain a Final state (the forked Isabelle theory generator cannot designate a terminal state, leaving deadlock-freedom unprovable). Implemented instead as mode 'Halted': entry Move(0,0) on both endTask transitions, then an absorbing tick self-loop with no action; obstacle/endTask are ignored in Halted.
issues.fix_directive: If a literal Final state is required for spec fidelity, rename SRangerMode.Halted to Final and remove its tick self-loop — but expect the Isabelle deadlock-freedom proof to become unprovable per CLAUDE.md.

issues.title: Move(lv, av) output encoded as a two-argument Actuator.move call (LOperations Call), not an event record
issues.raw: SR-DM4 describes a single output event Move carrying two reals. RoboChart events carry one payload; CLAUDE.md documents the multi-arg invocation route (LOperations interface + Call action). The controller therefore calls actuator.move(lv, av) directly in transition actions and no OutputEvent Java type exists.
issues.fix_directive: None needed unless the formal model must expose Move as a typed event channel; that would require a single-payload record encoding instead.

issues.title: Sensor no-reading default fixed at 100.0 m
issues.raw: SR-DM5 requires 'a large default value' when no reading is available but does not specify it. Chose 100.0 m (>> obstacleThreshold 0.5 m).
issues.fix_directive: Adjust Sensor.NO_READING_DEFAULT if the framework defines a canonical sentinel.

issues.title: Moving->Turning fires on obstacle event AND obstacleDetected guard
issues.raw: SR-Beh2 says the transition fires when the obstacle event is received; SR-GP1 says obstacleDetected (distance <= obstacleThreshold) is the guard on that transition. Implemented as the conjunction: event instanceof Obstacle && obstacleDetected. The guard is near-redundant (the IR framework only emits obstacle when the condition holds) but realises SR-GP1 verbatim as a named predicate.
issues.fix_directive: Drop the && obstacleDetected conjunct if the obstacle event alone should be authoritative.

next_step: Run the pipeline (compile -> coverage -> preflight -> t2m -> m2m -> m2t -> dafny_gen -> isabelle_gen) and iterate on visible feedback.
